convertibility_reason: Uses external .mqh libraries (Trade.mqh, SymbolInfo.mqh, DealInfo.mqh, PositionInfo.mqh) for trade execution and position management. Trading logic is entirely based on custom candlestick pattern recognition (Insider bars, White/Black birds, Zig levels) rather than standard built-in indicators. No standard MT5 indicator handles are used.

indicators.name: White Bird
indicators.derived_period: White_insider && r[2].close>r[2].open (bullish inside bar inside bullish bar)

indicators.name: Black Bird
indicators.derived_period: Black_insider && r[2].close<r[2].open (bearish inside bar inside bearish bar)

indicators.name: Zig Level Buy
indicators.derived_period: if bullish bar[1]: close-(close-open)/3; else: close-(close-low)/3

indicators.name: Zig Level Sell
indicators.derived_period: if bearish bar[1]: close+(open-close)/3; else: close+(high-close)/3

derived_values.name: Insider2
derived_values.used_by: Not directly used in signal logic (computed but unused)

other_exits: Close buy when Sell_signal && Confirm_sell && r[0].high<r[1].high (opposite signal with confirmation)
Close sell when Buy_signal && Confirm_buy && r[0].low>r[1].low (opposite signal with confirmation)

params.comment: SolveLots simply returns the input Lots value; MaximumRisk parameter mentioned in comment but not implemented

custom_logic_notes: Strategy is based on 'Eugene' inside bar breakout pattern. Uses 3-bar pattern recognition: bar[1] inside bar[2] (Insider), with bullish/bearish classification (White/Black Insider) and 2-bar inside pattern (White/Black Bird). Zig levels act as intrabar thresholds for confirmation. Time-based override: after hour>=8, confirmation is automatically true regardless of Zig level. InvertSignals input swaps all buy/sell signals. GlobalVariable mechanism prevents duplicate entries within the same bar. Close logic uses a weaker condition than entry (no r[1].low<r[2].high check for close-buy, no r[1].high>r[2].low check for close-sell). Insider2 variable is computed but never used in any signal logic.
python_conversion_notes: The core logic uses pure price action (MqlRates: open, high, low, close) with no standard indicator handles, making the signal logic straightforward to port. Key challenges: (1) Must replicate the candlestick pattern recognition (Insider, White/Black Bird, Zig levels) exactly. (2) The time filter uses dt.hour>=8 as an OR condition within Confirm_buy/Confirm_sell — this means after 8:00 server time, the Zig level check is bypassed. (3) GlobalVariable guard for once-per-bar entry must be replaced with a bar-index or timestamp tracking mechanism. (4) The CTrade, CSymbolInfo, CPositionInfo wrappers must be replaced with direct broker API calls. (5) StopsLevel check for SL/TP validity must be replicated. (6) InvertSignals mode simply swaps Buy/Sell and CloseBuy/CloseSell — trivial to implement. (7) Note that deviation is set to Sym.Spread()*3 points — this dynamic deviation must be preserved. (8) The entry Buy/Sell uses price=0 which in MQL5 means current market price.
